title: Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit — Base Bridge Days by How the Coverage Review Case Was Opened
content:
**Decision rule.** For an emergency supply under the Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit, the base bridge days depend on how the member's most recently opened coverage review case under the Utilization Management Program was opened:

- when the case is urgent and was opened by the prescriber, they are the network's emergency supply days less 2, but never fewer than one day;
- when the case is standard and was opened by the member or an authorized representative, they are 7;
- otherwise they are the network's emergency supply days.

The case's priority (urgent or standard) and who opened it are read from the member's coverage review case records.

## Decision table

| Case priority | Opened by | Base bridge days |
|---|---|---|
| Urgent | Prescriber | Emergency supply days less 2, at least 1 |
| Urgent | Member or authorized representative | Emergency supply days |
| Standard | Member or authorized representative | 7 |
| Standard | Prescriber | Emergency supply days |

## Figures by network

| Network | Emergency supply days | Urgent case opened by the prescriber | Standard case opened by the member or an authorized representative | Any other case |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Performance Network | 3 | 1 | 7 | 3 |
| Northbridge Essential Network | 3 | 1 | 7 | 3 |
| Northbridge National Network | 3 | 1 | 7 | 3 |
| Northbridge Preferred Savings Network | 3 | 1 | 7 | 3 |
| Northbridge Retail90 Network | 5 | 3 | 7 | 5 |
| Northbridge Open Choice Network | 5 | 3 | 7 | 5 |

On the networks whose emergency supply days are 3, an urgent prescriber-opened case gives 3 less 2, that is 1 day, which is also the floor of one day.
